data.rationale: The proposal follows the same procedure in the right order (converter, then holidays, then the ops email with the Sync subject and body). It gets four things wrong: it hardcodes "ahead" and a two-date holiday list, it ends with "Send" where the true workflow says Discard, it makes recipient_email a parameter although the recipient is fixed, and it never mentions the Mail tab switch. That Send error is risky, and the vague holiday navigation and the unnamed Discard step make it only partly automatable.
